summary.label: S-A medium grid diagnostic
summary.report_value_policy: Terminal values at the actual declared stop status. Last50 ranges retained to show remaining force drift. No claim of grid independence or physical validation.

first_default_criterion_evidence.locator: First current-model row with all printed solved-equation residuals <=1e-3; inherited rows excluded

summary.final_acceptance_reason: Current residuals meet actual <=1e-5 criteria and last100 drag/lift range/abs(mean) <=0.1%
summary.independent_review_status: Data processor reports numerical gates; independent review is recorded separately

brief_reference_comparison.scope: Comparison with the actual coursework reproduction at 8 degrees. Graphical reading allowances are not statistical confidence intervals. Convergence is separate from physical validation.
